LightningComponentBundle.description: White-label onboarding, KYC, and enablement dashboard. Renders checklists with progress, steps, and configurable branding. Works internally and on Experience Cloud.

property.name: checklistId
property.label: Checklist Id
property.description: Explicit Checklist record Id. Leave blank on a Checklist record page to use the current record.

property.name: configName
property.label: Branding Config Name
property.description: Dashboard_Config__c name to apply (e.g. Citi, Citizens, ICE). Blank uses the checklist's stored config.

property.name: isInternal
property.label: Internal View
property.description: On for ops/internal view (shows internal notes + actions). Off for client-facing view.
